legal.jurisdictionNote: Rates and rules are taken from the official sources listed next to every line of the calculation.

analytics._note: Analytics is off until an id is set. Cloudflare Web Analytics and Plausible are cookieless and need no consent banner; gaMeasurementId (G-XXXXXXXXXX) loads Google Analytics 4 behind the consent bar. Cloudflare counts page views and visits and cannot count unique visitors — it has no identifier at all. Plausible is what the unique-visitor number comes from: a hash of a daily-rotating salt with the IP and user agent, so nobody can be followed past midnight. Neither token is a secret; both are visible in the page they measure.
